Etiqueta comercial, no técnica: suele in: A marketing label, not a technical one: it usually marks the fast, cheap variant of a family, often an MoE with few active parameters. It is unrelated to Flash Attention; compare size, active parameters and benchmarks.
Marca una generación nueva de la arquite: Marks a new generation of the architecture (for example Qwen3-Next or Qwen3-Coder-Next), with internal changes such as hybrid attention or a sparser MoE. It needs a recent llama.cpp that recognises it.

Muestra de activaciones usada para decid: A sample of activations used to decide which weights need more precision during quantization. “i1-GGUF” repos (for example from mradermacher) are imatrix quantizations; “static” ones do not use it.
Formato de 4 bits de NVIDIA para GPU Bla: NVIDIA's 4-bit format for Blackwell GPUs, such as the Spark's GB10, which accelerates it in hardware. It scales each block of 16 values to lose less quality than INT4. Meant for vLLM, TensorRT-LLM or SGLang; it is not a GGUF.
Cuantizaciones dinámicas de Unsloth: dan: Unsloth dynamic quantizations: they give more bits to sensitive layers and fewer to the rest. At the same size they usually perform slightly better than a standard Q; K_XL is their largest variant within each level.
Pesos con solo tres valores (-1, 0, 1) o: Weights with only three values (-1, 0, 1) or very few bits. They take very little space, but the model must be trained that way from the start and needs specific kernels.
Usado por Gemma 3n y Gemma 4: el modelo: Used by Gemma 3n and Gemma 4: the model computes like one of that size but stores more weights, such as per-layer embeddings. Real memory use can exceed what the number suggests.
Mezcla capas de atención con capas de es: Mixes attention layers with state layers (Mamba, SSM or linear attention). It shrinks the KV cache and speeds up long contexts; it needs a llama.cpp or engine that knows the architecture.
Nano / Mini / Lite / Pro / Max / Ultra: Nano / Mini / Lite / Pro / Max / Ultra
Etiquetas comerciales de gama dentro de: Marketing tier labels within a family. They indicate relative size, not a technique; compare parameters, memory and benchmarks across vendors.
Variantes destiladas para generar en men: Distilled variants that generate in fewer steps, mostly for image and video. They are much faster, at the cost of some detail or prompt fidelity.
Un solo modelo que acepta y genera varia: A single model that accepts and generates several modalities: text, image, audio or video. It needs a runtime that supports every input and output you want to use.
Modelos especializados en leer texto de: Models specialised in reading text from images, scanned PDFs or tables. They are usually small and accurate, but not meant for chatting.
Ajustado para programar. FIM (fill-in-th: Tuned for programming. FIM (fill-in-the-middle) completes code between two fragments, which is what editor autocompletion uses.
Clasificadores que deciden si una petici: Classifiers that decide whether a request or response is safe. They sit in front of or behind the chat model; they do not answer like an assistant.
Ajustes comunitarios para escritura crea: Community tunes for creative writing and character roleplay. They favour style and continuity over accuracy; “unslop” means they try to avoid repetitive phrasing.
Cuantizaciones para Transformers, vLLM u: Quantizations for Transformers, vLLM or Optimum: W4A16 means 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations; bnb is bitsandbytes. They are not GGUF, so llama.cpp cannot load them.
Formatos para CPU Intel, NPU de Rockchip: Formats for Intel CPUs, Rockchip NPUs or phones. They do not use the Spark's GPU; look for the GGUF or safetensors version of the same model.
Etapas de entrenamiento posteriores al p: Training stages after pretraining. SFT teaches with examples; DPO and ORPO with pairs of preferred answers; GRPO and RL with rewards, common in reasoning models.
Modelo pequeño entrenado para imitar a u: A small model trained to imitate a larger one, such as R1-Distill or the community “Opus distill” models. It inherits style and reasoning, but not all of its knowledge; check the licence and where the data came from.
Fine-tune ajusta un modelo existente con: A fine-tune adjusts an existing model with its own data; CPT (continued pretraining) keeps pretraining it on lots of text from one language or domain. Quality depends on who made it and with what data.
Quantization-aware training: el modelo s: Quantization-aware training: the model is trained knowing it will be quantized. A 4-bit QAT version usually keeps more quality than quantizing afterwards.
Combina los pesos de varios modelos (SLE: Combines the weights of several models (SLERP, TIES, DARE…) without retraining. It can blend qualities, but results are uneven and depend heavily on the recipe.
An early release published for testing. It may change, have template bugs or disappear; for daily use prefer the stable version.
